AGENDA ITEMS AND ACTIONS
Meetings begin at 6:30 pm with the conduct of any business permitted to be conducted in closed session by the Brown Act (Government Code Section 54950, et seq.), if any, and with the public portion of the meeting beginning at 7:00 pm. There is a period for public comment on closed session matters at 6:30 pm prior to the closed session. In the event there is no business to be conducted in closed session, the regular meeting shall begin at 7:00 pm. There is a public comment period at the beginning of the regular meeting.  Any person wishing to comment shall be allotted three minutes per distinct item. Any meeting may be adjourned to a time and place stated in the order of adjournment.

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting on the City’s website and outside of City Hall. The agenda and related reports are also available for review online at www.cityofsignalhill.org.  

To view or listen to the meeting live at 7:00 p.m.: 

To view and participate (closed session at 6:30 p.m. and regular meeting at 7:00 p.m.):

A Regular Meeting of the Signal Hill City Council was held in-person in the Council Chambers and via video/teleconference on September 12, 2023.

(1). CALL TO ORDER – 6:40 P.M.

(2). ROLL CALL

(3). CLOSED SESSION

a.. A closed session will be held pursuant to Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(2).
Conference with legal counsel - anticipated litigation.
Significant exposure to litigation.

Number of potential cases: 1  -  Action: Held

(4). PUBLIC BUSINESS FROM THE FLOOR ON CLOSED SESSION ITEM There was no public business from the floor. 

(5). RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION – 6:41 P.M.

(6). RECONVENE REGULAR MEETING – 7:02 P.M.

(7). PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

(8). CLOSED SESSION REPORT City Attorney reported on closed session item. There was no reportable action taken.

(9). PUBLIC BUSINESS FROM THE FLOOR ON ITEMS NOT LISTED ON THE AGENDA Gege Lopez, Signal Hill resident, commented on the City's homeless services and resources brochure; homeless issues on Walnut Avenue and Reservoir Park; and a marijuana facility at 1600 E. 33rd Street, Long Beach.

(10). COMMUNITY ANNOUNCEMENTS

(11). PRESENTATIONS

c.. Chief Robertson with the Los Angeles County Fire Department will provide a general overview of fire services, calls, and response times for Fire Station 60 in Signal Hill.  -  Action: Tabled Agenda item 11c will be rescheduled to an upcoming City Council meeting.

b.. The Diversity Coalition Committee will provide a presentation on the upcoming Cultural Festival on Saturday, September 23, 2023.  -  Action: Held Samona Caldwell and Jon-Stephen Scott, Diversity Coalition Committee Members, presented agenda item 11b.

a.. Mayor Hansen will present a proclamation to Signal Hill resident Robert Cano in recognition of the 30th Annual Long Beach QFilms Festival.  -  Action: Held Mayor Hansen presented agenda item 11a.

d.. The Finance Director will introduce Daniel Basulto, Accountant for the City of Signal Hill.  -  Action: Held The Finance Director presented agenda item 11d.

(12). CITY MANAGER REPORT

a.. VERIFICATION OF QUORUM FOR FUTURE CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS  -  Action: Provided direction to staff Erin, Signal Hill resident, commented on the video feed of the Zoom meeting.

The City Council discussed agenda item 12a. and provided staff with direction.

(13). CONSENT CALENDAR

a.. CONTRACT AMENDMENT REGISTER DATED SEPTEMBER 12, 2023  -  Action: Approved (Pass) Moved by EDWARD WILSON

b.. RESOLUTION DECLARING FINAL ACCEPTANCE OF THE OHIO AVENUE STREET REHABILITATION FROM HILL STREET TO SKYLINE DRIVE (PROJECT NO. 90.23003) PURSUANT TO THE PUBLIC WORKS CONTRACT WITH PALP, INCORPORATED DBA EXCEL PAVING COMPANY  -  Action: Approved (Pass) Moved by EDWARD WILSON

c.. RESOLUTION DECLARING FINAL ACCEPTANCE OF THE WATER SERVICES AND VALVE REPLACEMENTS PHASE II PROJECT (PROJECT NO. 95.23008) PURSUANT TO THE PUBLIC WORKS CONTRACT WITH T.E. ROBERTS, INC.  -  Action: Approved (Pass) Moved by EDWARD WILSON

d.. RESOLUTION IMPLEMENTING NO OVERNIGHT PARKING ON ONE BLOCK OF CRESTON AVENUE AND WALNUT AVENUE AND AMENDING OVERNIGHT PARKING RESTRICTIONS ON A SEGMENT OF TEMPLE AVENUE  -  Action: Approved (Pass) Moved by EDWARD WILSON

e.. WARRANT REGISTER DATED SEPTEMBER 12, 2023  -  Action: Approved (Pass) Moved by EDWARD WILSON

f.. APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES  -  Action: Approved (Pass) Moved by EDWARD WILSON

(14). COUNCIL AGENDA--NEW BUSINESS

a.. Vice Mayor Woods will report on her attendance at the California Contract Cities Fall Summit September 8-10, 2023.  -  Action: Received and filed Vice Mayor Woods reported on her attendance at the California Contract Cities Fall Summit September 8-10, 2023.

Mayor Hansen stated that presentation 11c. will be rescheduled to an upcoming City Council meeting.

(15). ADJOURNMENT  -  Action: Adjourned (Pass) Moved by EDWARD WILSON
